name: dmengine-fumo-http
description: Mode C lab FUMO HTTP exchange: real dmengine with a lab DMCDEVINFO segment and loopback tree, triggered by OEM command code 0/field1=1, POSTs WBXML SyncML to a loopback mock endpoint. The mock returns a minimal WBXML SyncML response (Status 200 for the Alert/Replace commands and Final); the engine reports the SCOMO session state 1 with lastError 0 and does not abort. It performs no management operations and makes no update-success claim.
